news.title: Croatia 0-7 England: Thumping win reinvigorates Thomas Tuchel's project after World Cup blow - but next Spain test will define progress towards success
news.lede: "We will always have a scar, we will always feel pain and disappointment. But this is the way to move forward." Thomas Tuchel knows England's frustrating, much-criticised semi-final defeat to Argentina at the World Cup will hang over him and his team right through until the Euros in 2028 - and even beyond. But in Croatia on Saturday, a thumping 7-0 win was a performance and result to reinvigorate Tuchel's England project.

news.title: England recovering from FIFA World Cup semifinal heartbreak: Thomas Tuchel
news.lede: AP AP Photo/Darko Bandic https://ss-i.thgim.com/public/incoming/vuwviz/article71542851.ece/alternates/FREE_1200/Croatia_England_Nations_League_Soccer_66982.jpg Darko Bandic England's coach Thomas Tuchel returns the ball during the Nations League soccer match between Croatia and England in Rijeka, Croatia, Saturday, Oct. (AP Photo/Darko Bandic) Tuchel’s side was minutes away from qualifying for its first World Cup final since 1966 after taking the lead against Argentina in the semifinal, but conceded twice in the final five minutes to fall to defeat. Rijeka England manager Thomas Tuchel said that his side was beginning to get over the heartbreak of losing a FIFA World Cup semifinal after his side’s 7-0 demolition of Croatia in the UEFA Nations League 2026-27 on Saturday.

news.title: Arsene Wenger, African coaches to dissect record 2026 World Cup run
news.lede: Arsenal's French manager Arsene Wenger waves as he manages his final game for Arsenal, the English Premier League football match between Huddersfield Town and Arsenal at the John Smith's stadium in Huddersfield, northern England on May 13, 2018. FIFA’s Chief of Global Football Development, Arsene Wenger, will lead a panel of coaches behind Africa’s record-breaking performance at the 2026 FIFA World Cup at the CAF Strategy Conference in Cabo Verde next week. The Confederation of African Football disclosed this in a statement published on its website on Friday, announcing that Wenger would be joined by coaches including Cabo Verde’s Bubista, Egypt’s Hossam Hassan, Morocco’s Mohamed Ouahbi and Democratic Republic of Congo’s Sébastien Desabre.

news.title: Grey Cup Legacy Project brings 3 new flag football fields to Calgary
news.lede: A special celebration was held Saturday at Fonda Park, showcasing an empty and underused recreation space that will soon become three brand new flag football fields. “It’s a partnership between the Calgary Stampeders Foundation and the City of Calgary. This will be open for bookings and use as of April 2027, and these three dedicated flag football fields will create more opportunities for young athletes, families and communities from across the entire city to get active, come together, and connect through sports,” said Tourism Calgary’s senior vice-president of sales Carson Ackroyd. “Fonda Park was selected because it already has the infrastructure, the transit access, and parking needs to support increased recreational use.

news.title: Brazil shine on Selecao’s first visit to India
news.lede: Brazil's Vinicius Jr (right) in action during the international friendly match against India. (EPA Images pic) KOLKATA: Five-time World Cup winners Brazil showed glimpses of their class in a 4-0 win over India in a rare football friendly between the two nations in Kolkata on Saturday. India's hosting of a senior men's Brazil team for the first time had created buzz but a half-empty 65,000-capacity Salt Lake Stadium greeted the players. Critics blamed the pricing of tickets for the low attendance despite Brazil's top stars including Real Madrid forward Vinicius Jr and Marquinhos in the line-up.

news.title: Tuchel convinced England have buried World Cup woes with Croatia thrashing
news.lede: ‘We’ll always have a scar, but this is how we move forward’. Manager praises ‘complete package’ Scott on full debut. Thomas Tuchel said England have moved on from their World Cup pain after seeing his side deliver a statement performance in Rijeka and hand Croatia their biggest ever defeat. Tuchel was delighted after his front four combined to devastating effect at Stadion HNK Rijeka, where 6,200 local schoolchildren were allowed in free of charge even though the game was supposed to take place behind closed doors after Croatia were punished by Uefa for racist and discriminatory fan behaviour last year.

news.title: Fans, who saw Brazil at World Cup venues, glad to catch Selecao in city
news.lede: Kolkata: For fans who have followed Brazil and other football powerhouses at World Cup venues abroad, Saturday’s India-Brazil friendly at Salt Lake Stadium offered a different but equally special experience — watching the Selecao in action much closer home.Among them was Salt Lake resident Raja Banik, who arrived at the stadium in the same Brazil jersey he had worn while travelling to watch World Cup matches in Qatar and the US. Banik, who came with four friends, was supporting India on Saturday despite wearing Brazil colours.“. At Qatar, I watched almost all the league matches involving Brazil. I particularly remember Brazil’s matches against Cameroon and Switzerland.
